# atlassian_jira_permission_scheme (Data Source)

Look up a Jira permission scheme by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Permission scheme ID (e.g. 10000).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the permission scheme.
- `name` (String) Name of the permission scheme.
